description: Optimize PDF/EPUB reader experience: fix EPUB scrolling, improve PDF width, add collapsible reader panel

userStories.title: Fix EPUB scrolling issue
userStories.description: As a user, I want EPUB reader to scroll smoothly so I can read long chapters without interruption.
acceptanceCriteria: EPUB content area supports vertical scrolling
Scrolling is smooth without noticeable lag
Chapter title bar remains fixed during scroll
Chapter navigation updates scroll position correctly
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added flex-shrink-0 to header to keep chapter title bar fixed during scroll

userStories.title: Optimize PDF display width
userStories.description: As a user, I want PDF pages to use available width fully so content is not truncated or overly scaled.
acceptanceCriteria: Change width calculation from containerWidth - 40px to containerWidth - 20px
PDF content displays fully without horizontal truncation
Page shadows and margins remain visually appealing
Text remains readable at new scale
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add collapsible reader panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to collapse the left reader panel to give more space to the concept graph, and expand it when needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fold button (ChevronLeft icon) to reader panel header
Clicking fold collapses panel to 48px narrow bar
Narrow bar shows expand button (ChevronRight) and book title
Center panel expands automatically when left panel is collapsed
Clicking expand restores left panel to original 40% width
Collapse/expand animation is smooth (300ms transition)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented with smooth CSS transitions, vertical text for book title in collapsed state
